Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the business and occupation tax credits for employers of certain military personnel.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to business and occupation tax credits foremployers of certain military personnel; and adding a new section tochapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) In computing the tax due under this chapter, a credit isallowed as follows: (i) For a qualified entity with an employee who is a member of theWashington national guard or Washington state guard called to activeservice for an emergency declared by the governor under chapter 43.06RCW, a credit of one percent of the tax due under this chapter for theperiod that the employee is in active service for the purpose of suchemergency. (ii) For a qualified entity with an employee who is a member of theWashington national guard called to active service for a Title 10U.S.C. deployment, a credit of five percent of the tax due under thischapter for the period that the employee is deployed. p. 1 HB 1126 (b) "Qualified entity" means a small business as defined in RCW19.85.020, with an employee who is a member of the Washington stateguard or Washington national guard, and who retains the employee for aperiod of at least six months after the qualified period. (2) A person taking a tax credit under this section must make anannual report to the department. The report must be in a letter formand must include documentation showing the status of the employee andnotice of the call to active service or deployment. (3) No credit may be taken under this section for a call to activeservice or deployment prior to the effective date of this act. Norefunds may be granted for any credits due under this section.
